application_sentences: 4, 2012 Add Us On Google The INFICON helium leak detector UL3000 Fab (PLUS) is designed for the needs of leak testing in semiconductor applications.

"The handy device, which is designed for over 1,000 sprays per helium filling, replaces a remote control and combines its functions with those of a manual helium spray gun," says Product Manager Markus Schwambera, summarising the advantages.

These smart essentials are available worldwide SMART-Spray, I·BOOST and SPRAY-Check are suitable for all mobile INFICON helium leak detectors of the UL family, whereby I·BOOST is limited to the latest generation of UL devices (UL3000 Fab/UL6000 Fab series).
